@graph.headline: How to Use Help Scout: Setup Guide
@graph.description: Set up Help Scout step by step: connect email, add teammates, organize conversations, publish Docs, configure Beacon and test workflows.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect my support email to Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the Inbox settings, connect your domain address, copy the Help Scout Inbox address and configure forwarding with your email provider. Send a test message before switching the team.

mainEntity.name: How do I create a Help Scout knowledge base?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Settings, choose Docs Sites and create a site. Add a collection, then create, preview and publish articles from Tools > Docs.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Help Scout workflows on the Free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Help Scout lists workflows on Standard, Plus and Pro. The Free plan has an Inbox auto-reply feature, but not the paid workflow system.

mainEntity.name: What does Help Scout import from another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: The standard Import2 tool can bring conversations or tickets, customer profiles and tags from supported providers. Users, Inbox settings, knowledge base articles, saved replies and automation rules are not included.

mainEntity.name: Can I export Help Scout conversation threads?

acceptedAnswer.text: The in-app report export excludes conversation thread contents. Help Scout says other customer, user and conversation data can be obtained through the Inbox API, and Docs articles through the Docs API.
